task_name: Ironway Run Club - Numbering and club mark system
client_brief:
Rebuild our club lettering and use it in the Founders Five bib run

Ironway Run Club's lettering comes from Del's 1994 drawings. We want the ten numerals, twenty-six letters and singlet logo made usable again, followed by the Founders Five bib production.

The commission

 Ironway club mark: 1 named export. The source club identity is preserved.

 Race numeral: 10 named exports. The numeral is distinguishable from similar digits at viewing distance. The numeral follows Del's 1994 drawing.

 Club letter glyph: 26 named exports. The letter follows Del's 1994 drawing. The weight is consistent with the restored set.

 Founders Five member bib: 36 named exports. The runner number matches this member. The number is the dominant visual.

Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Permission restrictions in the owner's notes take precedence over inclusion in a source table.

Use the attached brand identity and the source files listed in the asset manifest. The output register defines exact filenames, pages, sizes and record bindings. Supporting previews are welcome but cannot replace those files.

brand_identity.sector: Volunteer run community road running club with its own spring race, printing kit and race bibs for its members.
brand_identity.founded_place_size: Founded 1994 by Del in Providence, Rhode Island. A volunteer run club with roughly thirty eight members on the books.
brand_identity.about: Ironway Run Club is a volunteer community running club in Providence with about thirty eight members. Its identity is the numbering the founder drew by hand in 1994, which the members treat as the club itself, and a screen printed club mark that survives on an old singlet. Each spring the kit goes to the heat transfer shop and every member runs the club's own Founders Five race with a bib.
brand_identity.audience: Members aged roughly 22 to 68, half of whom pin a bib on in the dark before a wet April race. Volunteers, not customers.
brand_identity.price_positioning: A forty dollar per season volunteer club with no sponsor. Everything printed must be cheap at volume and survive weather: one colour throughout, nothing that adds a plate or a pass, and nothing that looks like a paid entry event.
brand_identity.typography: The founder's hand drawn numerals and alphabet are the display face and the whole brand. A plain, sturdy sans handles member names and directory copy where legibility at a marshal's distance matters more than character.
brand_identity.voice: Friendly, plain, volunteer to volunteer. A line the club would write: "Founders Five is on. Pin your bib, mind the puddles, we will see you at the line."
brand_identity.brand_assets_status: No digital brand files exist. The numbering survives only as a phone photograph of the founder's original ink sheet on drafting paper, and the club mark only as a photograph of it screen printed on an old singlet. Nobody knows who made the mark and there is no file of either. Last year's bib survives as the printer's returned press PDF.
brand_identity.values: The founder's hand is the club, so it is kept faithfully. Legible beats clever, and every member gets the same thing for their forty dollars.
